title: The fact that Sabrina Carpenter only got to be on Broadway for 2 perf...
transcript: you know I was a fan of Sabrina Carpenter before this but her performance last night at the V m A's really really cemented how much I love her as an artist in case you did not watch the performance she performed her new single tears last night tears is this really fun infectious pop song really in the style that Sabrina Carpenter has come to love that is all about how hot she gets just when men do the bare minimum to respect a woman and Sabrina Carpenter chose to use her performance in the platform that she has to uplift the queer community at a time when gay and trans rights are being stripped away from people actively her background dancers heavily included drag Queens holding these protest signs including Protect Trans Rights and the male dancers that she featured are heavily pulled from the ballroom scene I think it says a lot especially right now in our country where politicians are actively trying to strip away rights of queer individuals especially trans people it says a lot to use your platform to essentially say you know you know what gets me wet basic basic respect and do you know who's respecting women right now gay men drag Queens trans women I don't think every performance needs to be a huge political statement but if you use your performance to make one I will have so much respect for you especially when it is as needed to highlight these issues as it is right now in this country and on top of all of that it was also an incredibly entertaining performance side note if you haven't watched the music video yet for tears she does the exact same thing uplifting drag Queens and ballroom culture Coleman Domingo is in it and it it's entirely Rocky Horror themed so if you haven't checked it out yet 10 out of 10 recommend and I'm just saying if Sabrina Carpenter wants to come back to Broadway we do have a Rocky Horror revival coming this year has Sam Pinkleton founded Janet yet
